🏪 Built for Small Businesses & Startups

🚀 A Simple Example

Imagine a small company building a Customer Management System.

Instead of manually creating the development workflow every time, the team can start with:

han init customer-system

Then continue building, testing, and managing the project using a consistent workflow.

Create → Develop → Test → Manage → Deploy
   │         │        │       │        │
   └─────────┴────────┴───────┴────────┘
                    han-cli
